description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_postgres' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to handle PostgreSQL-specific database schema operations within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for type mapping, SQL generation for schema changes, index management, and table alterations.

classes.name: ADODB2_postgres
classes.description: A class providing PostgreSQL-specific database schema manipulation methods for the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Maps PHP data types to PostgreSQL meta types.

methods.name: actualType
methods.description: Converts meta types to actual PostgreSQL data types.

methods.name: addColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add columns to a PostgreSQL table, handling default values and null constraints.

methods.name: dropIndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop an index.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter a column's definition, or recreates the table if necessary.

methods.name: dropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a column, depending on PostgreSQL version.

methods.name: _recreate_copy_table
methods.description: Creates a new table, copies data, and recreates indexes to modify table structure.

methods.name: dropTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a table and associated sequences.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix for column definitions, handling auto-increment.

methods.name: _dropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Finds and drops auto-increment sequences associated with a table.

methods.name: renameTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a table, considering schema.

methods.name: _indexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to create or replace an index.

methods.name: _getSize
methods.description: Determines the size and precision for column types.

methods.name: changeTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to change table structure, adding, altering, or dropping columns.
